business_summary: Art Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the provision of operation, management, and rental services of shopping malls and industrial parks in China. Art Group Holdings Limited was formerly known as Art Textile Technology International Company Limited and changed its name to Art Group Holdings Limited in September 2016. Art Group Holdings Limited is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Art Group Holdings Limited는 중국 내 쇼핑몰 및 산업 단지의 운영, 관리 및 임대 서비스 제공에 종사하고 있습니다. Art Group Holdings Limited는 이전에 Art Textile Technology International Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2016년 9월에 Art Group Holdings Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Art Group Holdings Limited는 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
